clips.title: The story
paras: "Speak with Bink" is an Alliance summons directing novice mages from Dun Morogh to the capital city of Ironforge. Dispatched by Magis Sparkmantle, the call sends promising spellcasters to assist Bink, an arcane researcher working out of the Hall of Mysteries.

Novice mages training in the cold crags of Dun Morogh eventually catch the eye of Magis Sparkmantle. Recognizing when an apprentice has outgrown the rudimentary exercises around Kharanos, Sparkmantle passes along word from his colleague, Bink. The request is specific and uncompromising: Bink requires an arcane specialist and refuses to trust the matter to anyone who cannot wield magic.

The assignment carries young mages into Ironforge's Mystic Ward, where scholars, priests, and arcanists convene beneath the soaring stone vaults of the Hall of Mysteries. Here Bink conducts her studies, evaluating arriving apprentices with sharp-eyed scrutiny. In her view, raw potential is merely a beginning; an undisciplined spellcaster quickly becomes a hazard rather than an asset in arcane matters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend! Bink, my gnome colleague in Ironforge, sends word. She has a task that needs doing and won't rely on anyone but a mage to do it! Are you that mage, friend?
If so, then speak with Bink. She spends her time in the Hall of Mysteries in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, I can see you have promise, yes you do! But it takes more than promise to be a good mage. And if you're not a good mage, then you're a bad mage. And bad mages are part of the problem, yes they are!
Oops, I'm getting ahead of things. Let's begin at the start!
